title: ToxiCraft: A Novel Framework for Synthetic Generation of Harmful Information

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating classification performance (Macro F1-score) on a sexism detection dataset (CMS - Call me sexist, but) to measure the model's ability to accurately identify gender-based abusive content using synthetically augmented training data.

Evaluating classification performance (Macro F1-score) on a political hate speech dataset (HTPO - Towards the Political Opponent) to measure the model's ability to identify politically motivated offensive language.

Evaluating overall classification performance (Macro F1-score) and cross-dataset robustness on general hate speech and offensive content datasets (AHSD, HASOC) to identify generalized toxic information.
